title: Multimodal Dataset Normalization and Perceptual Validation for Music-Taste Correspondences
abstract: arXiv:2604.10632v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Music and food traditions are both intangible cultural heritage, and the links between them, how a sound can make a taste seem sweeter or more bitter, are increasingly used in museum, exhibition and gastronomic-tourism settings. Modelling those links computationally runs into a data bottleneck familiar across cultural heritage computing: expert annotation is slow and costly, so the annotated collections that result are small. The usual remedy is to enlarge a collection automatically, labelling it with a model trained on the small annotated one. Such synthetic labels are rarely checked, either against the original annotations or against people. We provide both checks. Experiment 1 asks whether the audio-flavour patterns found in an experimental soundtrack collection (257 tracks annotated by listeners) survive when the collection is scaled to 49,300 30-second segments from the Free Music Archive (FMA) labelled by a fine-tuned Aud

translated_title: 面向音乐-味觉对应关系的多模态数据集归一化与感知验证
translated_abstract: 音乐与饮食传统均属于非物质文化遗产，二者之间的联系——即声音如何让味道显得更甜或更苦——正日益被应用于博物馆、展览和美食旅游等场景中。对这种联系进行计算建模会遭遇文化遗产计算领域普遍存在的数据瓶颈：专家标注缓慢且成本高昂，导致所获得的标注数据集规模很小。常见的解决方法是自动扩充数据集，即使用在小规模标注数据集上训练的模型对新数据进行标注。然而，这种合成标签很少经过检验，既没有对照原始标注，也没有对照真实人类的感受。我们提供了这两方面的检验。实验1探究了在一个由听众标注的实验性配乐数据集（257首曲目）中发现的音频-风味模式，当数据集扩展为由微调模型标注的来自Free Music Archive（FMA）的49,300个30秒音频片段时是否依然成立。
tldr: 该论文针对音乐-味觉对应研究中专家标注数据集规模过小的瓶颈，提出多模态数据集归一化方法，并通过感知实验双重验证了从小规模人工标注数据集扩展到大规模合成标注数据后音频-风味对应模式的有效性。
en_tdlr: This paper addresses the data bottleneck in music-taste correspondence research by proposing multimodal dataset normalization and perceptual validation, verifying that audio-flavour patterns from small expert-annotated collections remain valid when scaled to large datasets with synthetic labels.
